title: General English – Level 04 – Extensive Course
overview: General English – Level 04 is an intermediate English language program designed to strengthen learners' independence and confidence in everyday, social, academic, and workplace communication. Building on Level 03, the course develops more accurate and flexible grammar, a broader range of vocabulary, clearer spoken interaction, and the ability to understand and produce extended texts. Learners practice discussing opinions, explaining reasons, narrating experiences, and responding appropriately in familiar and less predictable situations. Integrated listening, speaking, reading, and writing activities support progression toward upper-intermediate study.
audience: Learners who have successfully completed General English – Level 03 or demonstrate equivalent pre-intermediate proficiency.
Adults and young professionals seeking stronger English communication skills for work, study, travel, and daily life.
Employees who need to participate more confidently in meetings, conversations, and written correspondence.
Individuals preparing to progress to higher-level General English or examination-oriented language training.
methodology: The program uses a communicative, learner-centered approach with guided language discovery, targeted grammar and vocabulary practice, interactive pair and group tasks, role plays, authentic reading and listening materials, short presentations, structured writing assignments, and regular corrective feedback. Initial diagnostic activities, formative checks, and a final integrated-skills assessment help monitor progress.
competencies: Intermediate listening comprehension and effective response to spoken English.
Sustained conversation, discussion, and presentation skills.
Accurate use of intermediate grammar structures and functional language.
Expanded topic-based vocabulary, collocations, and natural expressions.
Reading comprehension, inference, and text organization awareness.
Clear paragraph and short-text writing with appropriate tone and cohesion.
Self-correction, pronunciation clarity, and independent learning strategies.
objectivesIntro: By the end of this course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand main ideas and relevant details in extended conversations and moderately complex spoken texts.
Participate in discussions, express viewpoints, and support opinions with reasons and examples.
Use a wider range of tenses, modals, conditionals, and complex sentence patterns with improved accuracy.
Read articles, reports, and narratives to identify purpose, argument, supporting details, and implied meaning.
Write organized emails, descriptions, narratives, and opinion paragraphs using cohesive devices.
Communicate effectively in common workplace and social scenarios, including problem-solving and planning.
Monitor recurring language errors and apply strategies for continued independent improvement.
